description: SpellVisualKitEffect.EffectType says which table the row's Effect column points at, which is what makes Effect a polymorphic column rather than a foreign key: the .dbd cannot express a conditional reference, so 'points_at' carries it here instead. 'handler' names the build's dispatch bucket, and its absence means the type is named but not consumed. Survey 2026-07-18 covered the consumed types: 2 (SpellVisualKitModelAttach) is 100% redundant with the ParentSpellVisualKitID walk, and 10 (UnitSoundType) plays the target unit's own sound, so neither reaches a concrete file. The unconsumed types were left undeclared until 2026-08-21, when a value-space audit found six of them carrying rows on 9.2.7 -- type 3 the third most common of all -- so every value the enum defines is now named whether or not a route reads it. A type with no route is a stated gap; a type with no row here was an invisible one.

0.name: None
0.note: an empty row: Effect is 0 too. 5 rows on 1.15.9, none on 9.2.7

2.name: SpellVisualKitModelAttach
2.note: reached directly from the kit by the walk, so reading it here would be redundant rather than new

3.name: CameraEffect
3.note: 2,550 rows over 2,544 kits on 9.2.7, the most common unrouted type; table not downloaded

4.name: CameraEffect2
4.note: a second camera slot; 12 rows on 9.2.7

9.name: OutlineEffect
9.note: 126 rows over 91 kits on 9.2.7; table not downloaded

10.name: UnitSoundType
10.note: plays the target unit's own sound; no concrete file

15.name: CloneEffect
15.note: marked unused upstream, and no pack carries a row

16.name: GradientEffect
16.note: 266 rows over 265 kits on 9.2.7; table not downloaded
